restaurantName: Beach Road Fish Head Bee Hoon
address: Whampoa Makan Place, #01-46, 90/91 Whampoa Drive 91, 320091, Singapore
bio: The sliced fish bee hoon (rice vermicelli) comes in a flavourful, milky fish stock, with fried garlic bits for extra fragrance and crunch. Also worth trying are the tom yam soup, seafood soup and fried fish head bee hoon....
